limits: Address-space limit applies to each probe child via RLIMIT_AS; it is not an RSS/physical-RAM limit or 16 GB laptop qualification.
Analysis admission bounds actual captured input volume, not parser scratch/facts or in-memory captured source.
Separate processes and unique UUIDs; native watcher disabled, periodic recovery remains active; Node/browser timing absent.
A recovery status sample immediately precedes writes; this observes activity rather than proving every IO/parse overlap.
Each step verifies independent source discovery and completed changed-file facts. Restored final snapshots match complete capture.
RSS/phase peaks include probe input construction, source verification and independent fresh parses; verification is excluded from publication latency.
Single runs do not establish latency tails or randomized paired speedups.
